headline: Avenida Ataulfo de Paiva Surpasses Oscar Freire as Brazil's Priciest Retail Street
summary: Rio de Janeiro's Avenida Ataulfo de Paiva took top national rank after commercial rents on Sao Paulo's Oscar Freire dropped 26% over the past year.
why: Commercial real estate lease pricing reflects retail demand, consumer traffic, and commercial prime property trends in major South American cities.
